arguments.value: 19-year-old female with progressive refractory holocranial headaches, worsening dizziness, gait instability, and lower-extremity paresthesias was admitted for evaluation of a newly identified right pontine brainstem mass concerning for DIPG/infiltrating glioma, with transfer for biopsy prior to planned radiotherapy.
